what: periodic orbits (rotation angle 0) on satellite curves of Broucke's R family, refined to 30 digits with tools/refine-mp.py (u1 u2 lam t 30; the closure of the full period is measured on the rounded values written here): the second zeros of theta on the satellite curves of the T* = 17.847 and 19.769 orbits (n = 5 and 6, tools/family-follow.mjs), the zeros of theta on the upper branch for n = 7 and n = 9 to 12 (k = 1), and the three linearly stable zeros of the satellites with k > 1 (nu = 2/9 and 2/11 upper branch, nu = 3/10 lower branch; tools/branch-point.mjs with --k). tools/satellite-candidates.mjs recomputes T*, L*, word, alignments, repeats, stability and the comparison with other lists from them, and decides the pairs at the same period by the start values; tools/satellite-check.py checks the closure and the multiplier with REBOUND. The n = 7 orbit is the atlas entry bhhsat_r7_1_1; the others match nothing in the sources checked so far (the review of Li and Liao 2025 could not be read), which says nothing about whether they are known.
